description.value:
Prerequisites: Improved Critical feat with chosen weapon

The warrior can choose to take cumulative –2 penalties on all attack rolls to increase their critical threat range by 1 per -2 penalty imposed, up to a maximum of a -10 penalty and increase by 5. This bonus is applied after doubling critical threat range (such as from Improved Critical or Keen), and after any other such bonuses.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Advanced Warrior Talents
